description: Copy an image or video already uploaded to the project Files drive (via upload_project_drive_file) into the asset library, so it can be linked to a calendar row as linked_asset_id. Does not remove the drive file.

drive_file_id.description: Drive file id returned by upload_project_drive_file or list_project_drive.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

publisher_pid.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project.

upload_caption.description: Optional asset caption stored on the AR asset row.

upload_prompt.description: Optional prompt stored on the AR asset row.

name: asset_from_drive
